player_0.content: New plan: I failed to explore the full map because I repeatedly entered the same loop between the Closet and Sunroom without checking for unvisited neighbors or backtracking to discover new rooms. I need to implement a systematic exploration strategy: upon entering a new room, I must check all available directions. If a direction leads to a room I have not yet visited, I must go there immediately. If all immediate neighbors are already visited, I must backtrack to the previous room to explore other unvisited paths. I will also ensure the graph is updated correctly to reflect the current path and discovered connections before making the next move, avoiding the mistake of updating the graph with incorrect edge directions or missing nodes.
